02 / HCI

HCI

Human–Computer Interaction

Elevate Human Capability.

THE HCI VISION

Translating the digital experiences and connected realities of everyday life into workplace engagement, adaptability, and readiness.

01 / THE EMERGING PORTFOLIO

The HCI Technology Family

Seven concepts. One human-centered vision.

01 / HCI FAMILY●

HCI Orb

Precision tactile control to navigate workplace systems without a traditional mouse.

02 / HCI FAMILY●

HCI Ring

Wearable gesture technology to control applications through simple hand movements.

03 / HCI FAMILY●

HCI Touch

Adaptive touch interface for intuitive workplace navigation using taps, swipes, and gestures.

04 / HCI FAMILY●

HCI Audio

Voice-enabled earbuds for hands-free communication, instructions, and workflow assistance.

05 / HCI FAMILY●

HCI Hub

Connected workspace technology to coordinate devices, applications, and personalized work environments.

06 / HCI FAMILY●

HCI Controller

Game-inspired adaptive controller to navigate workplace applications using familiar gaming controls.

07 / DIGITAL WORKPLACE CONCEPT

HCI Connect

Social-inspired digital interface for workplace collaboration, learning, communication, and participation.

WHY WE EXPLORE HCI

Technology can create opportunity. It can also create barriers. We envision more intuitive, inclusive ways for people to engage with the systems they use.

Technology should work for people.

HCI images illustrate proposed technology concepts—not finished products or validated capabilities. Research, design, and development are ongoing or proposed, depending on the concept.
